sd_data_master.problem: The GET_RX_BD transition condition uses '>' (bd_cnt > READ_CYCLE-1) but the reference uses '>=' (bd_cnt >= READ_CYCLE-1). With READ_CYCLE=4, DUT transitions at bd_cnt>3 (bd_cnt>=4) while reference transitions at bd_cnt>=3, causing a one-cycle lag in the RX path. The DUT has default-zero assignments that clear all outputs every cycle, preventing signals from persisting across states.
